newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand, China sign securities repo agreement.
newsitem.headline: Thailand, China sign securities repo agreement.

text.p: The central banks of China and Thailand banks have signed a bilateral repurchase agreement as part of regional cooperation among Asian countries to stabilise their currencies during emergencies.
A central bank statement said the pact allows one central bank to borrow U.S. dollars from the other needed for intervention in foreign exchange markets in order to help stabilise its currency.
It said the U.S. dollar borrowing would be backed by U.S. government securities as collateral.
The Thai central bank said the agreement was similar to earlier repo pacts it signed with Japan, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia, Hong Kong, Singapore and the Philippines.
It did not reveal the ceiling of U.S. dollar borrowing provided by the agreement but said earlier that each bilateral pact has a $500 million limit.
Thailand and Singapore jointly intervened in currency markets earlier this month when the Thai baht came under heavy attacks.
